sections.title: Return by whom to be verified.
sections.text: The return of income under section 263 required to be furnished by the person specified in column B of the Table below shall be verified by the person specified in corresponding entry in column C of the said Table:

table.title: TABLE
columns: Person furnishing return of income B

rows.column_C: (i)Bythe individual himself; (ii) where the individual is mentally incapacitated from attending to his affairs, byhisguardian or anyotherperson competent to act on his behalf; (iii) where, for any other reason, it is not possible for the individual to verify the return, by any person duly authorised by him through a valid power of attorney.
(i)Bythekarta; (ii) where thekartais absent from India or is mentally incapacitated from attendingto his affairs,byanyother adult member of such family.

rows.column_B: A company in cases other than those mentioned at serial numbers 4, 5, 6 and 7.
rows.column_C: (i)Bythe managingdirector of the company; (ii) where there is no managing director, or the managing director is not able to verify the return due to any unavoidable reason, by any director of the companyor anyotherperson as maybeprescribed for verifyingthe return.

rows.column_B: A company not being resident in India.
rows.column_C: By any person holding a valid power of attorney from the company to do so.

rows.column_B: A company which is being wound up by orders of the Court or otherwise, or where any person has been appointed as receiver of any assets of the company.
rows.column_C: By the liquidator as referred to in section 322(1).

rows.column_B: A company whose management has been taken over by the Central Government or any State Government under any law.
rows.column_C: By the principal officer of the company.

rows.column_B: A company, for which application seeking corporate insolvency resolution process has been admitted by the Adjudicating Authority under section 7 or 9 or 10 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (31 of 2016).
rows.column_C: By the insolvency professional appointed by such Adjudicating Authority, where� "Insolvency professional" and "Adjudicating Authority" shall have the same meanings as assigned to them respectively in sections 3(19) and 5(1) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (31 of 2016).

(i)Bythe managing partner of the firm; (ii) where the managing partner is not able to verify the return due to any unavoidable reason, or there is no managing partner as such, by any partner of the firm,not beinga minor.

(i)Bythe designatedpartner of the limited liability partnership; (ii) where the designated partner of the limited liability partnership is not able to verify the return due to any unavoidable reason, or where there is no designated partner, by any partner of the limited liability partnership or any otherperson as maybeprescribed for verifyingthe return.
By the principal officer of the local authority.

rows.column_B: A political party as referred to in section 263(1)(a)(iii).
rows.column_C: By the chief executive officer of such political party (whether the chief executive officer is known as secretary or by any other designation).
(i)Byanymember of the association;or (ii)bytheprincipal officer of the association.
(i)Bytheperson himself;or (ii)byany person competent to act on his behalf.

Item 11 - Person furnishing return of income B: A political party as referred to in section 263(1)(a)(iii).; TABLE To be verified C: By the chief executive officer of such political party (whether the chief executive officer is known as secretary or by any other designation)..
